task_h_special_audit.assessment: Task H in UCIP-23 is degenerate as a discriminative classification task because 100% of records have is_abstention=True and target_response='Information not provided in context.' No non-abstention control records exist within Task H itself (control ungrounded probes are tested against Tasks C-G). A trivial majority-class baseline achieves 100.0% by simply memorizing this single target string.
